name: The Station — Garden Deck
_note: Owner, log 20261006-01: 'add a garden to the place and I need it to match very much my garden here ... on the space station ... not OpenStreetMap, it's not going to be accurate enough ... a more real walkable scale, so that to walk across the garden in the game takes twice as long as in real life ... a second screen attached to the space station.' Drawn from his own garden narrations in the archive (the garden-update videos of 2025-02 to 2026-01): black-painted raised wooden beds he built, a row of about thirty onions, the tomato in its cage with the blue drip line, the pigeon pea tree planted too close to the roof edge, the banana tree with the flowers a friend brought planted on its shaded side, a corn patch, the driveway edge where he puts cuttings. The videos are close-ups, so the LAYOUT is a best arrangement, not a survey: his photo pass corrects it. Scale: about 2 m per tile, half real walking speed by his ruling. No address anywhere.

interactables.label: The onion bed
text: A raised bed, the boards painted black.
About thirty onions in a row, just set. "I'm just going to leave them there."

interactables.label: The tomato
text: One tomato plant in a cage, a blue drip line looped at its feet.
Baby tomatoes on it, in January, with a cold snap coming. It stays out.

interactables.label: The beds he built
text: Three more beds, dark planks, built in a weekend with a timelapse running.
Corn went in here last. "I think I can get one more growing season before the winter."

interactables.label: Pigeon pea tree
text: A pigeon pea tree, grown from one pea put in the ground.
Planted a little too close to the roof edge. It grew up into it anyway.

interactables.label: Banana tree
text: On its shaded side, the flowers a friend brought to hang, planted instead to see if they take.

interactables.label: The patch
text: Seedlings in a staked bed, and a yellow bucket somebody left.

interactables.label: The plaza
text: A paved square in the middle of the deck, the drip line running out from a tap at its corner.
Up here the water comes from the station. Down there it came from the hose.

interactables.label: The driveway edge
text: The strip along the drive where cuttings go in to see what takes.
"I just planted them directly next to a spot here in the driveway."
